fullReading.title: Every finding in the chart
fullReading.lead: The three priorities at the top of your report are drawn from this set. Everything the engine matched is here, each with the placement it rests on, so you can see the reasoning rather than only the conclusion.
fullReading.patternsLead: Each card states the reading, then the placement behind it. Open “Why this reading” to see the technical basis and how common the pattern is.
fullReading.combinationsHeading: Patterns that run for a lifetime
fullReading.combinationsLead: Yogas are combinations rather than single placements, and they describe standing conditions in the chart rather than a passing period.
fullReading.karmaLead: A secondary reading of what the chart suggests was carried in, where it asks to be released, and the kind of work it points toward.
